operator_observation: MIM explained training needs_attention but incorrectly ranked judgment-mode repair as the top repair even though the focused V2 judgment suite was at 100%.
root_cause: Studio training reply template hardcoded judgment mode as the top repair.
The reply did not merge the scoreboard outcome_reflection fields when the hourly reflection shape did not expose stale_artifacts directly.
Lower-level canned training replies still implied judgment repair was active rather than resolved/green.
fix: Treat judgment mode as a good signal when pass_rate_percent is at or above 80.
Rank outcome reflection gap, stale artifacts, blocked objective pressure, and TOD validation baselines as the active attention items.
Use outcome_reflection fallback fields for stale artifact count and names.
Update canned communication-composer training replies to reflect that judgment is green and stale evidence is the blocker.
validation: Live Studio MIM reply says stale artifact count is 12.
Live reply names stale artifacts including TOD_EXECUTION_RESULT.latest.json and TOD_VALIDATION_RESULT.latest.json.
Live reply says MIM judgment mode is currently green, not the top repair.
Live reply recommends refreshing/retiring stale reflection artifacts and binding TOD validation metrics.
training_lesson: MIM must not repeat stale weakness text when newer score evidence shows the weakness is resolved. Current pass/fail evidence outranks old weakness labels.
